theme: Arrived in Dubrovnik; clear the sailing logistics before you go off-grid.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik, Dan, with the Old Port out the window and the kids' stretch with Jen underway. Today was all transit, and these next three days are your last window with real signal before the charter, so the boat-and-transfer details are worth clearing while you can.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfer and early checkout
needsAttention.detail: You step off the boat at noon Sept 19 and fly out pre-dawn Sept 20. Pre-book the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, confirm the hotel will hold bags before the 3 PM check-in, and arrange the ~5:15 AM express checkout now, while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding details
needsAttention.detail: Reach the charter instructor to pin down Saturday's boarding time and place and the airport return transfer. Connectivity goes poor once you're underway, so do this from Dubrovnik rather than the dock.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental outright
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV at Tampa is no longer a hedge; it's needed for the Orlando drive. Book it now rather than walking up jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Check the St Pete Airbnb converted
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27-Oct 5 St Pete booking was pending host acceptance on a 24-hour window; make sure it flipped to confirmed rather than expiring. The Sept 20-21 landing gap still needs a room.

schedule.title: Land in Dubrovnik
schedule.detail: LH4296 from Frankfurt, then into the Old Port apartment

flagged.title: Valoris wants a call on the Nomura idea
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano is floating a real project for Nomura and still wants to schedule a call; the thread has moved on to placement-agent and consultant intros.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, promos, and a campaign blast: Bloomberg, Lumosity, HBO, the Press Herald.
inbox.clear: Otherwise just confirmations: the Airbnb welcome, a PayPal charge, a baggage receipt, and your BA Visa payment posting.

resolved.title: Dubrovnik apartment is set
resolved.detail: Host Damjan sent the Old Port address and welcomed you in; check-in went through cleanly.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel booked
resolved.detail: Remisens Epidaurus is locked for Sept 19, sea-view family room, free cancellation until Sept 15.

resolved.title: BA Visa payment posted
resolved.detail: Chase confirmed your British Airways Visa payment was applied; nothing owed there.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's early apples are crisp and abundant now — the season made for baking.

acts.line: The red-eye put you into Frankfurt before dawn, then the 9:15 connection carried you south to Dubrovnik.
Off the plane by mid-morning and into the Old Port apartment, with Damjan holding the address and keys.
Croatia runs hours ahead of this page's clock, so you're already deep into the first night in the old town.
